    1. postProcessPersistenceUnitInfo(MutablePersistenceUnitInfo)

Interface PersistenceUnitPostProcessor

public interface PersistenceUnitPostProcessor
Callback interface for post-processing a MutablePersistenceUnitInfo configuration that Spring prepares for JPA persistence unit bootstrapping.

实现可以通过DefaultPersistenceUnitManager注册，或者通过LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean进行注册。

Since:
2.0
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller
